matches.rationale: Finding 1 correctly identifies the rotation matrix error in Equation 3, noting that the coefficient should be (1 − cosθ) not (1 + cosθ), and provides mathematical justification via small-angle expansion. This directly detects the defect in the same equation and material.

Finding 2 identifies the undefined β term in the loss function equation, noting that βt is never defined and makes the training objective ambiguous. This directly detects the introduced undefined notation in the same equation (zt = αt z0 + βt δt ε).

No finding addresses the dimensional inconsistency in zmotion (R^{k×5×h×w} vs R^{k×3×h×w}). The findings focus on the rotation matrix formula and the undefined β term, but do not mention the channel dimension mismatch in Section 3.2.
